goal: A normal provider must require only provider selection and an API key; templates, headers, endpoints, response extraction and model selection are DORN responsibilities.
automaticFlow: Encrypt the API key separately from headers and request JSON.
Query the provider model endpoint and replace a retired default when possible.
Send a real minimal response request.
Activate only after the real request succeeds; otherwise keep it disabled with an actionable error.

advancedOnlyReasons.openai-images: Uses the specialized image workflow rather than a chat response contract.
advancedOnlyReasons.cloudflare-workers-ai: Requires an account identifier that cannot be derived safely from an API key alone.
advancedOnlyReasons.generic-json: A private endpoint necessarily requires its private request and response contract.

officialContractsChecked.result: Responses API and gpt-5.6-sol model identifier confirmed.
Messages endpoint and required authentication/version headers confirmed.
OpenAI-compatible base URL, Bearer authentication, chat endpoint and gemini-3.7-flash confirmed.
Local /api/chat request and message response contract confirmed.
Chat completion contract and model discovery recommendation confirmed.

limitations: No external provider is marked live-verified without a user-owned key and a successful real request.
Providers may change model catalogs; DORN discovers models at connection time instead of trusting only a hard-coded identifier.
Specialized image, audio and video generation continue through their typed product runtimes, not a generic chat template.
